text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way back from an outing with
Meisho
Doto when she asks to stop by
the sporting goods
store.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for dragging you along... My
shoes never
seem to last very long...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I must be falling over too much—that
must be it.
I've tried to be more
cautious, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Doto? So, you're looking to buy
some new
shoes too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look over and meet the intimidating
gaze of a
punkish Umamusume. If I'm not
mistaken, this is
Doto's roommate, Air
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... are you planning on buying
something,
Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm heading out. This place's
supposed to be
where all the
sneakerheads go, but a shop that

doesn't show product specs isn't worth
my time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: See ya, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto is yet to take her eyes off
Air
Shakur, even as she walks off.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing, except... she couldn't
pick out...
any shoes.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering... maybe I can
change that?
I've been such a nuisance
to her up till now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so forgetful... and Shakur knows that,
so she
makes the effort to check in on
me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to give her my thanks, but... I
always figure
she'll just find it annoying.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Although... maybe I can help her find
what she's
looking for.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! Let's hurry!
choice_data_list: もう1度、声かけてみるか？

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Shakur, w-wait a second!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto? Look where you're going, or else
you'll fall.
You want something?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I just, um, would like to help
you with
your shopping...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I go through my shoes very quickly... so
I've tried
on quite a few in my time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've even made notes on all the shoes
I've owned
and how I ruined them.
Maybe you could make
some use of it...
or maybe not.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whoa... So you've kept records of how durable your shoes were. Can't say I'm not interested.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What're you trying to get out of me,
though? Info
like this doesn't come for
free.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, I didn't mean anything like that... I
just want
to repay you, since you're
always... looking... out
for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Since when? I don't watch anyone's back
but my
own, so if you wanna strike a
deal, make it quick.
C'mon.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-make it quick? But, I... Wh-what
should I do,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. Your trainer's pretty sharp. I don't
usually
let people see my training.
Y'know, data privacy
and all that.
choice_data_list: 代わりに練習に付き合ってもらったら？
そっちのオススメも教えて！

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, th-that makes sense. T-training with
someone
like me would only cause you
trouble... I'm s-so
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's cool. I don't mind... if you let me
have a
thorough look at that data of
yours when we're
back at the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can do that, no problem! But... is that
really
okay for you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I later learn that their data analysis
lasted well
into the night, and Meisho
Doto was elated to
have been
considered useful.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If that's your idea of making things
even... Try the
brand over by the
entrance. Either the red or
purple ones.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All the specs are written out on their
website. The
red ones are made to last.
The purple ones have
good grip, so
they'll help you trip less.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Considering your running style and
flexible knees,
I'd say those two are your
best bet.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-wooow... Thank you very much! I'll,
um, buy
them both!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Both? Has anyone ever told you you put
way too
much faith in others? Whatever.
Send me the data
you've recorded after
trying them out.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Okay, got it! I'll buy them now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto is more than excited to
head back
inside. She must be really
happy Air Shakur gave
her some advice.
